A null-to-nonnull replacement across those calls can expose the indeterminate centers.

Current complete candidate deliberately leaves center_x/center_y conditional. A stable null Sprite never evaluates them in C++; a Sprite present at centering supplies the original display-size coordinates even if its receiver is later replaced. Do not initialize to zero as an unapproved behavior change, assume arbitrary rendering callbacks cannot mutate state, or count undefined-domain host runs as positive proof.

This is a preserved original behavior boundary, not authorization to change it. Native matching, table/layout checks and defined-domain tests do not prove complete reentrant rendering or game acceptance. Existing painting/creation and map hierarchy findings stay pending.
